title: Print several lines
instructions_md:
## One call, one line

Python runs your program from top to bottom. Each `print()` starts a new line.

```python
print("Breakfast")
print("Lunch")
```

```text
Breakfast
Lunch
```

## Your task

Print a countdown. Show `3`, `2`, `1` and then `Go!`, each on its own line.
hints: Count how many lines the screen must show.
Write four calls to `print()`, from `3` down to `Go!`.
starter_code: # Write your countdown below this line.

tests.name: Prints `3`, `2`, `1`, `Go!` on four lines
tests.hint: Each item needs its own line, in this order.
